message: エンジェリックエクストラ

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder if everyone's starting to get the hang of using Spirit Arts by now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I've got enough firepower to stir-fry in a wok, at least.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I have an all-you-can-drink supply of delicious natural water anytime.」

name: Misa
message: 「I think I'd be fine running the air conditioner, microwave, and hair dryer all at once.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh~ Sounds like we'll be able to save a ton on utility bills with that!」

name: Ria
message: 「What about you, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nothing that's really helpful for the household budget yet...」

name: Misa
message: 「How pathetic.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How disappointing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Get it together!」

name: Ria
message: 「U-Um, well, it's power meant for fighting demons, after all.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「We are managing to beat the demons showing up one after another, so... I'd like to think we're making progress.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to get stronger in a more visible way. Like growing huge, or combining.」

name: Misa
message: 「C-Combining?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Demons like Sally are showing up now, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Neither Sally nor Macaron are bad girls, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Better safe than sorry. An eye for an eye, as they say!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, do you have some kind of surprise?」

name: Ria
message: 「Um, well, that thing I got from my big sister...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yep! I was thinking we could do some training so everyone can get a little stronger♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~! Is it gigantification after all? Or a super transformation? I'm so excited.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah♪ I thought I'd have you all learn some new techniques.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it's what you'd call a new special move! The kind that's rumored to always come out when a strong enemy appears and puts you in a pinch!」

name: Misa
message: 「We aren't in a pinch at all right now, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Better safe than sorry, right? Honestly, it's not like a new move is just gonna conveniently burst out when we're actually in trouble.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone here does tend to choke under pressure, after all~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, we were already taught how to use Spirit Arts. Is there another way to do things, Ria-senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh... I could've sworn it was written right around here...」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, hey! Look over there!」
I was forced to look away.

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! That's where the Guardian Angel sealed inside the Rosary makes its grand entrance!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahhh, I get it, an angel!」

name: Misa
message: 「You just remembered that now, didn't you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it never makes a peep, so it's easy to forget. Right, Lolo-chan.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angeeeel!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Is a Guardian Angel's power different from Spirit Arts?」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh...? U-Umm, well, that's... uh...」

name: Ria
message: 「Tweet-tweet!」
I was made to do an about-face.

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! Crusaders and their Guardian Angels constantly share consciousness, and when their synchronization rate reaches its peak...」

name: Ria
message: 「The Guardian Angel's power awakens in this world, entrusting immense strength to the Crusader... yes!」

name: Misa
message: 「How mystical...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. Impressive as always, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alrighty. Then let's try calling out to the angel right away--hellooo!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yeees♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「--Wait, I'm not an angel!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yeees♪」

name: Misa
message: 「He's still at it...\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「It's really not going well.」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought raising your Spirit Power would be the best way to synchronize, you know~? Guess that's not all it takes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Synchronizing our consciousness... Does that mean understanding what the Guardian Angel is thinking and tuning in to it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It doesn't say a word, so I have no clue. Do you know, Lolo-chan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's see. It is thinking about what is for dinner tonight.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's just you.」

name: Synn
message: 「A Guardian Angel, huh. I don't even get why one's hidden inside the Rosary in the first place, and I wonder if it's even really there...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-Hey, Synn! Behind you, behind you!」

name: Synn
message: 「What's wrong.」

name: Ria
message: 「Just now, faintly behind Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? A ghost!? Gyaaaah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, it is not! That is... an angel.」

name: Ria
message: 「So that's... a Guardian Angel...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun. How did you just do that!?」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't do anything, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You mean you can summon it without doing anything?」

name: Misa
message: 「Then I can do it too... Mmmmm... Mmph, mmmmmm!!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's weird. I can't call it out anymore.」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe it just wanted to let you know it really is there.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, it totally looked like it was sulking!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh, did I make her mad!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Having just the vice president in a bad mood is more than enough.」

name: Misa
message: 「Mmmmm~~!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huff, huff... Well? Did they appear?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not at all.」

name: Misa
message: 「~~Grrrr!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So they really are there after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Way to go, Synn. You pulled it off first try. Not that it helps our household budget, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「That doesn't even matter!\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「With the angel's power, we have nothing to fear! I must become just like the president too.」

name: Misa
message: 「If Sakura-kun can do it, then I can do it too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shall we get right down to business, then?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah! Let's all do our best~~!」
And so, their special training to master this new power began.
